name: 🎃 [HALLOWEEN] Hunting Together RPG
desc:
⚔️ Hunting Together is a classic fantasy MMORPG! Hunt monsters on floating sky islands, master 8 classes, collect cards and refine epic gear with friends.

🎃 [HALLOWEEN EVENT] Spooky village, Pumpkin Spiders and limited Halloween weapon skins!
🎁 CODE: HALLOWEEN = FREE EXP + Drop Potions!

Grab your weapon and start your adventure from a cozy sky-island village.
🗺️ Explore forests, deserts, snowfields and a volcano full of monsters and bosses
🧙 8 classes: Swordsman, Mage, Archer, Thief, Cleric, Merchant, Samurai, Alchemist
🃏 Collect monster cards and slot them into your gear
🔨 Refine your weapons, reroll options and build your own playstyle
🤝 Party up: share EXP with friends at any level and take down bosses together
🐾 Pets, mounts, titles and an Adventure Book to complete

📱 Play on PC, mobile and tablet!

FAQ
Q: Can I play with friends who are a higher level?
A: Yes! Party EXP is shared at any level gap.
